criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: Line 1 names subject, role, org, and the 'first major carrier' decision. Line 2 pivots immediately to structural tension. Decision is the hook, not the bio. Minor ding: 'in April' slightly imprecise vs. April 16.

criteria.name: Subject + decision load-bearing for AK
criteria.notes: Subject's role has direct operational scope over the Anchorage maintenance base at Ted Stevens International. No dollar figure available from dossier; workforce impact at the Anchorage base is inferred rather than quantified.

criteria.name: Subject identification fidelity
criteria.notes: Full name, role (VP of Maintenance Operations), and org (Alaska Airlines) in line 1. Anchorage tie explicit. All facts match dossier.

criteria.name: Decision specificity + primary-source
criteria.notes: Decision named with what, when, binary. Independent corroborating source named inline (ePlane AI News, April 16). Date within broadened 90-day window. Minor: does not distinguish primary-source URL inline.

criteria.name: Structural read
criteria.notes: Takes a clear, debatable position: the decision is defensible, but the communication framing overstates certainty for a pre-production validation phase. Critiques Engel's quote language directly. Not neutral, not boosterism.

criteria.name: Forward implication
criteria.notes: Named concrete signals: Q3/Q4 2026 10-Q filings, Tailsight customer announcements, second-carrier test. Date window specific. Minor: does not name a next decision Engel himself owns.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Analytical, structural, position-taking throughout. No hagiographic verbs, no banned phrases. One minor soft moment: 'a genuine de-risking signal'.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: Paragraphs 2-4 sentences. Word count 426 within range. Total chars ~2,874 under cap. Bio one sentence. Scannable on mobile and desktop.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Tied to post's central analytical tension. Debatable, not generic. Minor: 'If you were the VP' framing introduces slight role-play persona.

criteria.name: Anti-puff guard
criteria.notes: No hagiographic verbs. Bio one sentence. Four+ paragraphs on decision treatment and structural critique. Explicitly states communication choice was suboptimal.

hard_fail_checks.detail: Zero em-dashes, en-dashes, double-hyphens, colons, or semicolons in body.

hard_fail_checks.name: total_char_count_under_linkedin_cap
hard_fail_checks.detail: Total post length ~2,874 characters, under 3,000 cap.

hard_fail_checks.name: subject_named_and_anchorage_tied
hard_fail_checks.detail: Nathan Engel + VP of Maintenance Operations + Alaska Airlines named in line 1; Anchorage tie named in paragraph 2.

hard_fail_checks.name: recent_decision_named_with_primary_source
hard_fail_checks.detail: April 16 announcement cited. Decision dated April 16, 2026, within broadened 90-day window. ePlane AI News corroborator named inline.

hard_fail_checks.name: multi_source_corroboration
hard_fail_checks.detail: Alaska Airlines Newsroom (primary) + ePlane AI News (independent corroborator) both documented in dossier. ePlane AI News independent of subject's org.

hard_fail_checks.name: not_a_puff_piece
hard_fail_checks.detail: Clear position: decision defensible but communication overstates certainty. Critiques Engel's quote framing directly.

hard_fail_checks.name: no_invented_quotes
hard_fail_checks.detail: Engel quote verbatim-matched to dossier subject_quotes[0].verbatim.
